logp.method_description: The lipophilicity of the complexes was determined using the shake-flask method.Briefly, water and n-octanol were pre-saturated by mixing at a 1 : 1 (v/v) and shaking for 48 h at room temperature, followed by phase separation. Subsequently, Ru1-3 was add to the pre-saturated water and n-octanol (1 : 1, v/v). The mixture was shaken for 48h and then centrifuged at 1000 rpm for 3 min. The concentration of the complexes in each phase was determined by UV-visible spectroscopy. The logarithm of the stratified solution absorbance ratio is the log Po/w of the complex.
